fields.definition: take revenge for a perceived wrong
fields.definitionSentence: To revenge means to take revenge for a perceived wrong.
fields.definitionZh: 因自认为受到伤害或冒犯而实施报复。
fields.example: He revenged himself on the rival who had publicly insulted him by revealing the rival's deception.
fields.exampleZh: 他揭露了对手的骗局，以报复对方曾公开侮辱自己。

fields.definition: imagine to be the case or true or probable
fields.definitionSentence: To suspect means to imagine something to be the case, true, or probable.
fields.definitionZh: 推测某种情况可能属实或很可能发生。
fields.example: I suspect the delay was caused by a fault in the control system.
fields.exampleZh: 我怀疑这次延误是控制系统故障造成的。

fields.definition: an ordered array of the components of an emission or wave
fields.definitionSentence: A spectrum is an ordered array of the components of an emission or wave.
fields.definitionZh: 辐射或波的各个成分按顺序排列而成的阵列。
fields.example: The prism separated the beam into a spectrum of distinct colors.
fields.exampleZh: 棱镜把这束光分解成由不同颜色组成的光谱。

fields.definitionSentence: Something described as vacant is without an occupant or incumbent.
fields.definitionZh: 没有人占用，或没有人在任的。
fields.example: After the director resigned, the position remained vacant for three months.
fields.exampleZh: 主任辞职后，这个职位空缺了三个月。

fields.definition: receive guests as a host and provide them with food, drink, or other hospitality
fields.definitionSentence: To entertain means to receive guests as a host and provide them with food, drink, or other hospitality.
fields.definitionZh: 作为主人接待宾客，并为其提供饮食或其他款待。
fields.example: The couple entertain several neighbors at home every New Year's Eve, serving dinner and arranging guest rooms.
fields.exampleZh: 这对夫妇每年除夕都在家款待几位邻居，为他们准备晚餐和客房。

fields.definitionSentence: Resolution means the trait of being resolute.
fields.example: The climber's resolution remained firm when bad weather delayed the expedition.
fields.exampleZh: 恶劣天气耽误了探险行程，但这名登山者的决心依然坚定。

fields.definition: a reflex motion caused by cold or fear or excitement
fields.definitionSentence: A shiver is a reflex motion caused by cold, fear, or excitement.
fields.definitionZh: 由寒冷、恐惧或兴奋引起的反射性颤抖。
fields.example: A sudden shiver ran through her when the icy wind entered the tent.
fields.exampleZh: 冰冷的风灌进帐篷时，她突然打了个寒战。

fields.definition: made from or largely consisting of silver
fields.definitionSentence: Something described as silver is made from or largely consists of silver.
fields.definitionZh: 由银制成或主要含银的。
fields.example: The museum displayed a silver cup beside the gold coins.
fields.exampleZh: 博物馆在金币旁陈列了一只银杯。

fields.definitionZh: 具有很大多样性或种类丰富的。
fields.example: The library's versatile collection ranges from medieval manuscripts to digital media.
fields.exampleZh: 这座图书馆的藏品种类丰富，从中世纪手稿到数字媒体都有。

fields.definitionZh: 容易变化或反复无常的。
fields.example: His versatile temperament shifted from enthusiasm to irritation within a single meeting.
fields.exampleZh: 他的性情反复无常，在一次会议中就从热情转为烦躁。

fields.meaning: 多才多艺的，能胜任多种工作的
fields.definition: competent in many areas and able to turn with ease from one thing to another
fields.definitionSentence: Someone described as versatile is competent in many areas and can turn with ease from one thing to another.
fields.definitionZh: 能胜任多个领域，并能轻松从一项工作转到另一项的。
fields.example: The versatile engineer can design circuits, write control software, and explain the system clearly to clients.
fields.exampleZh: 这位多才多艺的工程师既能设计电路、编写控制软件，也能向客户清楚讲解系统。
他对那场打斗的说法与我的不同。
